alphabet_convention: Alphabet convention: Standard ASL manual alphabet A-Z; J and Z handled as dynamic gestures; M and N use standard ASL forms.
authority: User explicitly authorized excluding samples whose saved landmarks do not follow the hand or miss important fingertips, while preserving all original images. Missing-blur cases were re-evaluated individually.
method: Inspect existing original images, saved landmark contact sheets and saved HTML SVG coordinates. No extraction, MediaPipe, model inference, threshold change or pipeline rerun. Exclusion concerns landmark/image correspondence, not relabeling. Static overlays do not measure stability.

observations.evidence: The saved overlay concentrates on the folded/palm region and terminates below the two clearly visible extended upper digits. It does not trace their full length or important tips. Exclude the landmark sample; do not convert its K label to T.

In the C-to-G panel, most of the saved skeleton is at the lower-left edge beside the face rather than spanning the raised cupped hand. Major finger/palm correspondence is displaced. The user's correct C label does not make this feature vector valid.

In the Q-to-C panel, the saved skeleton occupies the folded central fingers and does not reach the two long downward index/thumb tips visible in the original. Their major segments are absent. Preserve confirmed Q semantics but exclude the malformed landmark vector.

In the D-to-O panel, the skeleton ends among the curled fingers below the clearly raised index fingertip; the extended index is not followed to its tip. Preserve the user's D label but exclude the landmark sample.

Original image is 104 by 120 pixels. All 21 saved overlay points lie in x=12.6125744581..17.3087134361, y=22.7621912956..45.1990807056: a narrow left-edge strip, not the visible fist/palm extending substantially to the right.
